description: This file defines a React context provider component named PreferencesProvider that manages user preferences such as theme and accessibility options. It loads preferences from an API when the user is authenticated, allows updating preferences, and syncs theme preferences with document attributes.

methods.name: PreferencesProvider({ children })
methods.description: React functional component that provides user preferences context and manages preference state.

methods.name: fetchPrefs()
methods.description: Async function called within useEffect to load user preferences from API when user context changes.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Callback to update a preference key-value pair, persist it via API, and handle theme attribute updating.
